tool_schemas.name: list_tables
tool_schemas.description: Lists tables for the given Supabase project, optionally filtered by Postgres schema, returning results from the specified snapshot or from a fresh introspection when `refresh` is true; the response is paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor` for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id`/`snapshot_id` formats are invalid, `limit` is out of range, or unsupported fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project or snapshot does not exist (or the snapshot does not belong to the project). May raise RATE_LIMITED when introspection is throttled and CONFLICT if `refresh` cannot run due to the project being in a non-inspectable state.

snapshot_id.description: Optional schema introspection snapshot ID to read tables from instead of live inspection.

refresh.description: When true, triggers a fresh introspection and returns the latest tables.

schema.description: Optional Postgres schema name to filter tables by (e.g., public).

limit.description: Maximum number of tables to return.

tool_schemas.name: list_extensions
tool_schemas.description: Lists Postgres extensions enabled in the given project, reading from a snapshot when provided or performing live introspection when `refresh` is true; results are paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, cursor, or `limit`, and for unknown parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to inspect the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project or snapshot is missing or mismatched. May raise RATE_LIMITED when introspection is throttled and CONFLICT if a refresh cannot be performed due to project state.

snapshot_id.description: Optional schema introspection snapshot ID to read extensions from instead of live inspection.

refresh.description: When true, triggers a fresh introspection and returns the latest extensions.

limit.description: Maximum number of extensions to return.

tool_schemas.name: list_migrations
tool_schemas.description: Lists database migrations recorded for the given project, optionally filtered by `status`, using the provided snapshot or a fresh introspection when `refresh` is true; results are paged via `limit` and opaque `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, `limit`, `status` value format, or unknown fields; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access, and NOT_FOUND if the project or snapshot doesn’t exist or doesn’t belong to the project. May raise RATE_LIMITED when introspection is throttled and CONFLICT if migration metadata cannot be refreshed because the project is not in an inspectable state.

snapshot_id.description: Optional schema introspection snapshot ID to read migrations from instead of live inspection.

refresh.description: When true, triggers a fresh introspection and returns the latest migrations.

status.description: Optional migration status filter as recorded by the project (if available in snapshot data).

limit.description: Maximum number of migrations to return.

tool_schemas.name: apply_migration
tool_schemas.description: Applies a named/versioned migration to the project database by executing the supplied DDL SQL, recording the migration metadata (and optional `checksum`), or performing a validation-only plan when `dry_run` is true; returns the recorded migration entry and execution outcome. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, IDs are malformed, or extra fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you’re not allowed to modify the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if a migration with the same `migration_version` is already recorded (or the recorded checksum/name does not match), if the project is in a state that refuses schema changes, or if the migration cannot be applied due to ordering/consistency rules; may raise RATE_LIMITED when write operations are throttled.

project_id.description: Target Supabase project ID to apply the migration to (ULID).

migration_version.description: Migration version identifier (often a timestamp-like string).

sql.description: DDL SQL text to apply as a migration.

checksum.description: Optional checksum of the migration SQL for tracking/verification.

dry_run.description: When true, validates/plans the migration without applying it.

tool_schemas.name: execute_sql
tool_schemas.description: Executes the provided SQL against the project Postgres database with optional `params`, and returns the execution result (and any returned rows when applicable); when `read_only` is true, the request is restricted to read-only execution on a best-effort basis. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty SQL, malformed project ID, invalid params, or unknown fields; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to run SQL, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if `read_only` is true and the statement attempts to write/DDL, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when execution is throttled.

project_id.description: Target Supabase project ID to execute SQL against (ULID).

sql.description: SQL text to execute (prefer apply_migration for DDL).

params.description: Optional parameter values for parameterized SQL execution.

tool_schemas.name: list_edge_functions
tool_schemas.description: Lists Edge Functions for the given project, optionally filtered by `status` (active/archived), returning a paged result set controlled by `limit` and an opaque `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed project ID, invalid `status`, out-of-range `limit`, or unknown fields; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when listing is throttled.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID whose Edge Functions should be listed (ULID).

status.description: Optional status filter for Edge Functions.

limit.description: Maximum number of Edge Functions to return.

tool_schemas.name: deploy_edge_function
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates an Edge Function identified by `slug` in the given project by deploying `source_text`, creating a new version when the function already exists, and returning the function record and deployed version metadata (including any stored `description`, `entrypoint_path`, `runtime`, and `deploy_metadata`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/empty required fields, invalid project ID, unsupported runtime value, or unknown properties; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you’re not allowed to deploy to the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. Raises CONFLICT if the project refuses deployments due to its current state, if the slug conflicts with naming rules or an existing function cannot be versioned, and may raise RATE_LIMITED when deployments are throttled.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID to deploy the Edge Function to (ULID).

slug.description: Function slug (unique name) to create or update.

source_text.description: Deno Edge Function source code to deploy.

description.description: Optional description for the Edge Function.

entrypoint_path.description: Optional entrypoint path (stored metadata) for the function.

tool_schemas.name: get_logs
tool_schemas.description: Fetches recent log lines for the specified `service` in a project, limited to the last `since_seconds` (max 60) and capped by `limit`, returning the most recent matching lines. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed project ID, missing/invalid `service`, out-of-range `since_seconds`/`limit`, or unknown fields; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the project logs, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when log access is throttled.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID to fetch logs for (ULID).

service.description: Service type to fetch logs for (e.g., api, db, auth, functions).

since_seconds.description: How far back to fetch logs in seconds (max 60 seconds).

limit.description: Maximum number of log lines to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_project_url
tool_schemas.description: Returns the project’s API URL for the given `project_id`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when requests are throttled.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID to fetch the API URL for.

tool_schemas.name: get_anon_key
tool_schemas.description: Returns the project’s anonymous (public) API key for the given `project_id`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `project_id` is malformed or unknown fields are provided; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the project, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist. May raise RATE_LIMITED when requests are throttled.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID to fetch the anonymous API key for.

tool_schemas.name: generate_typescript_types
tool_schemas.description: Generates and returns TypeScript type definitions for the specified project based on its current database schema. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is missing or does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access the project.

project_id.description: Supabase project ID to generate TypeScript types for.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def generate_typescript_types(project_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0198000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0198000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"

    t0 = time.time()
    status_code = "ok"

    allowed = {"project_id"}
    unknown = [k for k in _extra.keys() if k not in allowed]
    if unknown:
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unknown field(s) provided.", fields=sorted(unknown))
    elif not isinstance(project_id, str):
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id must be a string.")
    else:
        pat = re.compile(r"^sup_proj_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,26}$")
        if not pat.match(project_id):
            status_code = "error"
            resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id is malformed.")
        else:
            projects = _load("projects.json")
            proj = next((p for p in projects if p.get("id") == project_id), None)
            if not proj:
                status_code = "error"
                resp = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Project not found.")
            elif proj.get("status") != "active":
                status_code = "error"
                resp = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Project is not active.")
            else:
                # Types should reflect current schema; use latest completed snapshot.
                snaps = _load("schema_introspection_snapshots.json")
                completed = [s for s in snaps if s.get("project_id") == project_id and s.get("status") == "completed"]
                completed.sort(key=lambda s: s.get("completed_at") or s.get("updated_at") or "", reverse=True)
                snap = completed[0] if completed else None

                # If none exists, create + complete a snapshot as per business rules used by list_* tools
                if snap is None:
                    now = _now()
                    snap_row = {
                        "id": _new_id("snap"),
                        "project_id": project_id,
                        "source": "on_demand",
                        "pg_version": None,
                        "tables": [],
                        "extensions": [],
                        "migrations": [],
                        "status": "running",
                        "error_message": None,
                        "started_at": now,
                        "completed_at": None,
                        "created_at": now,
                        "updated_at": now,
                    }
                    snaps.append(snap_row)
                    _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)

                    # Complete immediately with what we have (empty snapshot is allowed by schema constraints)
                    now2 = _now()
                    snap_row["status"] = "completed"
                    snap_row["completed_at"] = now2
                    snap_row["updated_at"] = now2
                    _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)
                    snap = snap_row

                # Create operation row and run it (queued->running->succeeded)
                ops = _load("db_operations.json")
                now = _now()
                op_id = _new_id("op")
                op = {
                    "id": op_id,
                    "project_id": project_id,
                    "tool_name": "generate_typescript_types",
                    "operation_kind": "types",
                    "sql_text": None,
                    "migration_name": None,
                    "migration_version": None,
                    "migration_checksum": None,
                    "params": {"project_id": project_id},
                    "result": None,
                    "stdout": None,
                    "stderr": None,
                    "error_message": None,
                    "status": "queued",
                    "started_at": None,
                    "finished_at": None,
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                }
                ops.append(op)
                _save("db_operations.json", ops)

                # Transition queued->running
                now_run = _now()
                op["status"] = "running"
                op["started_at"] = now_run
                op["updated_at"] = now_run
                _save("db_operations.json", ops)

                # Generate a minimal but deterministic types file from snapshot tables
                tables = snap.get("tables") if isinstance(snap.get("tables"), list) else []
                def _ts_ident(s):
                    s = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", str(s))
                    if not s or re.match(r"^[0-9]", s):
                        s = "_" + s
                    return s

                lines = []
                lines.append("// Generated by Supabase MCP Server (offline model)")
                lines.append(f"// project_id: {project_id}")
                lines.append(f"// snapshot_id: {snap.get('id')}")
                lines.append("")
                lines.append("export type Json = string | number | boolean | null | { [key: string]: Json } | Json[];")
                lines.append("")
                lines.append("export namespace Database {")
                lines.append("  export namespace Public {")
                lines.append("    export interface Tables {")
                for t in tables:
                    schema = (t.get("schema") or "public") if isinstance(t, dict) else "public"
                    name = (t.get("name") or "unknown") if isinstance(t, dict) else "unknown"
                    if schema != "public":
                        # For simplicity, only emit public tables in this minimal model
                        continue
                    tn = _ts_ident(name)
                    lines.append(f"      {tn}: {{")
                    # Try to infer columns if present; otherwise empty record
                    cols = t.get("columns") if isinstance(t, dict) else None
                    if isinstance(cols, list) and cols:
                        lines.append("        Row: {")
                        for c in cols:
                            cn = _ts_ident((c.get('name') if isinstance(c, dict) else "col"))
                            lines.append(f"          {cn}: Json;")
                        lines.append("        };")
                    else:
                        lines.append("        Row: Record<string, Json>;")
                    lines.append("      };")
                lines.append("    }")
                lines.append("  }")
                lines.append("}")
                ts = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

                sha = hashlib.sha256(ts.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
                size = len(ts.encode("utf-8"))

                # Succeed
                now_done = _now()
                op["status"] = "succeeded"
                op["finished_at"] = now_done
                op["updated_at"] = now_done
                op["result"] = {
                    "artifact": {
                        "kind": "typescript_types",
                        "bytes": size,
                        "sha256": sha,
                    },
                    "snapshot_id": snap.get("id"),
                    "tables_emitted": sum(
                        1 for t in tables
                        if isinstance(t, dict) and (t.get("schema") or "public") == "public"
                    ),
                }
                op["stdout"] = "types generated"
                _save("db_operations.json", ops)

                resp = {
                    "project_id": project_id,
                    "snapshot_id": snap.get("id"),
                    "operation_id": op_id,
                    "types": ts,
                    "artifact": op["result"]["artifact"],
                }

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    for log_name in ("request_logs.json", "usage.json", "audit_logs.json"):
        path = os.path.join(_DB, log_name)
        if os.path.exists(path):
            logs = _load(log_name)
            logs.append({
                "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}",
                "tool": "generate_typescript_types",
                "project_id": project_id,
                "status": status_code,
                "latency_ms": latency_ms,
                "created_at": _now()
            })
            _save(log_name, logs)
            break

    return resp

tool_schemas.name: create_branch
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new development branch from the specified production project and returns the created branch record, including the new branch project reference/ID to use for subsequent branch operations. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id or name is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the production project does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to create branches for the project, and CONFLICT if a branch operation is already in progress or a branch with the same name cannot be created.

project_id.description: Production Supabase project ID to create a development branch from.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the development branch.

created_by.description: Identifier for the actor creating the branch (e.g., user email or username).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def create_branch(project_id, name, created_by=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0198000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0198000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _new_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}"

    t0 = time.time()
    status_code = "ok"

    allowed = {"project_id", "name", "created_by"}
    unknown = [k for k in _extra.keys() if k not in allowed]
    if unknown:
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unknown field(s) provided.", fields=sorted(unknown))
    elif not isinstance(project_id, str):
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id must be a string.")
    elif not re.match(r"^sup_proj_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,26}$", project_id):
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id is malformed.")
    elif not isinstance(name, str) or len(name) < 1:
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "name must be a non-empty string.")
    elif created_by is not None and (not isinstance(created_by, str) or len(created_by) < 1):
        status_code = "error"
        resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "created_by must be a non-empty string when provided.")
    else:
        projects = _load("projects.json")
        branches = _load("branches.json")
        snaps = _load("schema_introspection_snapshots.json")

        prod = next((p for p in projects if p.get("id") == project_id), None)
        if not prod:
            status_code = "error"
            resp = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Production project not found.")
        elif prod.get("environment") != "production":
            status_code = "error"
            resp = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "project_id must refer to a production project.")
        elif prod.get("status") != "active":
            status_code = "error"
            resp = _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Production project is not active.")
        else:
            # CONFLICT if branch name already exists under this production project (unique constraint)
            if any(b for b in branches if b.get("production_project_id") == project_id and b.get("name") == name):
                status_code = "error"
                resp = _err("CONFLICT", "A branch with this name already exists for the production project.")
            else:
                # Create branch project row
                now = _now()
                branch_project_id = _new_id("sup_proj")
                # make project_id look like required pattern: sup_proj_ + base32-ish
                # If our generated id doesn't match, generate a compliant one deterministically.
                if not re.match(r"^sup_proj_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,26}$", branch_project_id):
                    alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
                    seed = hashlib.sha256(f"{time.time()}:{os.getpid()}:{name}:{project_id}".encode("utf-8")).digest()
                    token = "".join(alphabet[b % len(alphabet)] for b in seed)[:20]
                    branch_project_id = f"sup_proj_{token}"

                # Ensure uniqueness by regenerating token if necessary
                existing_ids = {p.get("id") for p in projects if isinstance(p, dict)}
                existing_refs = {p.get("project_ref") for p in projects if isinstance(p, dict)}
                attempt = 0
                while branch_project_id in existing_ids and attempt < 5:
                    attempt += 1
                    seed = hashlib.sha256(f"{time.time()}:{os.getpid()}:{attempt}:{name}:{project_id}".encode("utf-8")).digest()
                    token = "".join("0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"[b % 32] for b in seed)[:20]
                    branch_project_id = f"sup_proj_{token}"

                if branch_project_id in existing_ids:
                    status_code = "error"
                    resp = _err("CONFLICT", "Unable to allocate unique branch project id.")
                else:
                    # Create a unique project_ref too (stable external identifier)
                    token_ref = hashlib.sha256(f"ref:{branch_project_id}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
                    project_ref = f"br_{token_ref}"
                    attempt = 0
                    while project_ref in existing_refs and attempt < 5:
                        attempt += 1
                        token_ref = hashlib.sha256(f"ref:{branch_project_id}:{attempt}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
                        project_ref = f"br_{token_ref}"

                    if project_ref in existing_refs:
                        status_code = "error"
                        resp = _err("CONFLICT", "Unable to allocate unique branch project ref.")
                    else:
                        # Branch constraints:
                        # environment='branch' => parent_project_id not null
                        # api_url starts_with https://
                        api_url = f"{(prod.get('api_url') or 'https://example.supabase.co').rstrip('/')}/branch/{project_ref}"
                        if not api_url.startswith("https://"):
                            api_url = "https://example.supabase.co/branch/" + project_ref

                        branch_project = {
                            "id": branch_project_id,
                            "project_ref": project_ref,
                            "name": f"{prod.get('name', 'project')} / {name}",
                            "environment": "branch",
                            "parent_project_id": project_id,
                            "region": prod.get("region"),
                            "api_url": api_url,
                            "db_host": None,
                            "db_name": None,
                            "anon_key": prod.get("anon_key") or "",
                            "service_role_key": prod.get("service_role_key"),
                            "status": "active",
                            "created_at": now,
                            "updated_at": now,
                        }
                        if not branch_project["anon_key"]:
                            status_code = "error"
                            resp = _err("CONFLICT", "Production project is missing anon_key required to initialize branch.")
                        else:
                            projects.append(branch_project)

                            # Create branches row with status creating
                            branch_id = _new_id("branch")
                            branch = {
                                "id": branch_id,
                                "production_project_id": project_id,
                                "branch_project_id": branch_project_id,
                                "name": name,
                                "created_by": created_by,
                                "last_operation_id": None,
                                "status": "creating",
                                "last_error": None,
                                "created_at": now,
                                "updated_at": now,
                            }
                            branches.append(branch)

                            # Ensure production has a completed snapshot (needed to reflect migrations)
                            prod_completed = [s for s in snaps if s.get("project_id") == project_id and s.get("status") == "completed"]
                            prod_completed.sort(key=lambda s: s.get("completed_at") or s.get("updated_at") or "", reverse=True)
                            prod_snap = prod_completed[0] if prod_completed else None
                            if prod_snap is None:
                                # Create and complete an empty snapshot for production
                                snap_now = _now()
                                prod_snap = {
                                    "id": _new_id("snap"),
                                    "project_id": project_id,
                                    "source": "on_demand",
                                    "pg_version": None,
                                    "tables": [],
                                    "extensions": [],
                                    "migrations": [],
                                    "status": "running",
                                    "error_message": None,
                                    "started_at": snap_now,
                                    "completed_at": None,
                                    "created_at": snap_now,
                                    "updated_at": snap_now,
                                }
                                snaps.append(prod_snap)
                                _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)
                                done = _now()
                                prod_snap["status"] = "completed"
                                prod_snap["completed_at"] = done
                                prod_snap["updated_at"] = done

                            # Create branch snapshot that mirrors production migrations; complete it
                            snap_now = _now()
                            branch_snap = {
                                "id": _new_id("snap"),
                                "project_id": branch_project_id,
                                "source": "post_migration",
                                "pg_version": prod_snap.get("pg_version"),
                                "tables": list(prod_snap.get("tables") or []),
                                "extensions": list(prod_snap.get("extensions") or []),
                                "migrations": list(prod_snap.get("migrations") or []),
                                "status": "running",
                                "error_message": None,
                                "started_at": snap_now,
                                "completed_at": None,
                                "created_at": snap_now,
                                "updated_at": snap_now,
                            }
                            snaps.append(branch_snap)

                            # Persist project + branch + snapshots (running state)
                            _save("projects.json", projects)
                            _save("branches.json", branches)
                            _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)

                            # Complete branch snapshot and set branch ready once migrations reflected
                            done = _now()
                            branch_snap["status"] = "completed"
                            branch_snap["completed_at"] = done
                            branch_snap["updated_at"] = done

                            branch["status"] = "ready"
                            branch["updated_at"] = done

                            # Save final state
                            _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)
                            _save("branches.json", branches)

                            resp = {
                                "branch": branch,
                                "branch_project": {
                                    "id": branch_project.get("id"),
                                    "project_ref": branch_project.get("project_ref"),
                                    "api_url": branch_project.get("api_url"),
                                    "environment": branch_project.get("environment"),
                                    "parent_project_id": branch_project.get("parent_project_id"),
                                    "status": branch_project.get("status"),
                                    "created_at": branch_project.get("created_at"),
                                }
                            }

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    for log_name in ("request_logs.json", "usage.json", "audit_logs.json"):
        path = os.path.join(_DB, log_name)
        if os.path.exists(path):
            logs = _load(log_name)
            logs.append({
                "id": f"req_{int(time.time()*1000)}_{os.getpid()}",
                "tool": "create_branch",
                "project_id": project_id,
                "status": status_code,
                "latency_ms": latency_ms,
                "created_at": _now()
            })
            _save(log_name, logs)
            break

    return resp

tool_schemas.name: list_branches
tool_schemas.description: Lists development branches for a production project and returns a paged result set sorted as requested; pass limit and an opaque cursor from the previous response to retrieve the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, sort/order, limit, or cursor values, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view branches for the project.

project_id.description: Production Supabase project ID whose development branches should be listed.

status.description: Optional filter to return only branches with the given status.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: delete_branch
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified development branch and returns the updated branch record (or deletion acknowledgement) reflecting the deletion state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if branch_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the branch does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to delete it, and CONFLICT if the branch is already deleted or is in a non-deletable in-progress state (for example, merging, rebasing, or resetting).

tool_schemas.name: merge_branch
tool_schemas.description: Merges a development branch’s migrations and Edge Functions into production and returns the branch record reflecting the merge job state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if branch_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the branch does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to merge to production, and CONFLICT if the branch is not in a mergeable state (for example, creating, deleting, failed) or if another branch operation is already in progress.

branch_id.description: Branch ID whose migrations and edge functions should be merged to production.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def merge_branch(branch_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, hashlib, secrets

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0198000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0198000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    endpoint = "merge_branch"
    t0 = time.time()

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _reqlog(status_code, project_row_id=None, message=None, extra=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": "req_" + os.urandom(9).hex(),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_id": None,
            "project_id": project_row_id,
            "status": status_code,
            "message": message,
            "extra": extra or {},
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            "created_at": _now_iso(),
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        return f"{prefix}_{hashlib.sha256(f'{time.time_ns()}:{secrets.token_hex(8)}'.encode()).hexdigest()[:24]}"

    # Accept sup_br_* or branch_project_id sup_proj_*
    if not isinstance(branch_id, str) or not branch_id.strip():
        _reqlog("VALIDATION_ERROR", None, "Invalid branch_id", {"field": "branch_id"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "branch_id must be a non-empty string.", field="branch_id")
    bid = branch_id.strip()
    is_branch_ulid = re.match(r"^sup_br_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,26}$", bid or "") is not None
    is_proj_ulid = re.match(r"^sup_proj_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{16,}$", bid or "") is not None
    if not (is_branch_ulid or is_proj_ulid):
        _reqlog("VALIDATION_ERROR", None, "Invalid branch_id format", {"field": "branch_id"})
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid branch_id.", field="branch_id")

    branches = _load("branches.json")
    projects = _load("projects.json")
    snaps = _load("schema_introspection_snapshots.json")
    efs = _load("edge_functions.json")
    efv = _load("edge_function_versions.json")
    if not all(isinstance(x, list) for x in (branches, projects, snaps, efs, efv)):
        _reqlog("CONFLICT", None, "Datastore corrupted")
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Datastore is not in the expected format.")

    br = None
    if is_branch_ulid:
        br = next((b for b in branches if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("id") == bid), None)
    else:
        br = next((b for b in branches if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("branch_project_id") == bid), None)

    if not br:
        _reqlog("NOT_FOUND", None, "Branch not found", {"branch_id": bid})
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Branch not found.", branch_id=bid)

    if br.get("status") in ("deleted", "deleting"):
        _reqlog("CONFLICT", br.get("branch_project_id"), "Branch is deleted/deleting", {"status": br.get("status")})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Branch is deleted or deleting.", status=br.get("status"))

    if br.get("status") != "ready":
        _reqlog("CONFLICT", br.get("branch_project_id"), "Branch not mergeable", {"status": br.get("status")})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Branch is not in a mergeable state.", status=br.get("status"))

    prod_id = br.get("production_project_id")
    branch_pid = br.get("branch_project_id")
    if not prod_id or not branch_pid:
        _reqlog("CONFLICT", None, "Branch record missing project linkage")
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Branch record is missing required project linkage.")

    # Begin merge: set status merging
    br["status"] = "merging"
    br["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
    _save("branches.json", branches)

    try:
        # Copy Edge Functions: for each function slug in branch project, deploy as new version into production
        now = _now_iso()

        prod_funcs = [f for f in efs if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("project_id") == prod_id]
        branch_funcs = [f for f in efs if isinstance(f, dict) and f.get("project_id") == branch_pid]

        def _find_prod_fn_by_slug(slug):
            for f in prod_funcs:
                if f.get("slug") == slug:
                    return f
            return None

        # Build map of latest deployed version in branch
        for bf in branch_funcs:
            slug = bf.get("slug")
            if not slug:
                continue
            active_vid = bf.get("active_version_id")
            bv = None
            if active_vid:
                bv = next((v for v in efv if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("id") == active_vid), None)
            if bv is None:
                # fallback: highest version_number
                candidates = [v for v in efv if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("function_id") == bf.get("id")]
                candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("version_number") or 0, reverse=True)
                bv = candidates[0] if candidates else None
            if bv is None:
                continue

            pf = _find_prod_fn_by_slug(slug)
            if pf is None:
                pf = {
                    "id": _gen_id("efn"),
                    "project_id": prod_id,
                    "slug": slug,
                    "description": bf.get("description"),
                    "entrypoint_path": bf.get("entrypoint_path"),
                    "active_version_id": None,
                    "runtime": bf.get("runtime") or "deno-edge",
                    "status": "active",
                    "created_at": now,
                    "updated_at": now,
                }
                efs.append(pf)
                prod_funcs.append(pf)

            # create new production version
            existing_prod_versions = [v for v in efv if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("function_id") == pf.get("id")]
            max_vn = 0
            for v in existing_prod_versions:
                vn = v.get("version_number")
                if isinstance(vn, int) and vn > max_vn:
                    max_vn = vn
            new_vn = max_vn + 1

            # supersede current active
            prior_active = pf.get("active_version_id")
            if prior_active:
                for v in efv:
                    if isinstance(v, dict) and v.get("id") == prior_active and v.get("function_id") == pf.get("id") and v.get("status") == "deployed":
                        v["status"] = "superseded"
                        v["updated_at"] = now
                        break

            new_ver = {
                "id": _gen_id("efv"),
                "function_id": pf.get("id"),
                "project_id": prod_id,
                "version_number": new_vn,
                "source_bundle_sha256": bv.get("source_bundle_sha256"),
                "source_text": bv.get("source_text"),
                "deploy_metadata": bv.get("deploy_metadata") or {},
                "status": "deployed",
                "error_message": None,
                "created_at": now,
                "updated_at": now,
            }
            efv.append(new_ver)
            pf["active_version_id"] = new_ver["id"]
            pf["updated_at"] = now

        _save("edge_functions.json", efs)
        _save("edge_function_versions.json", efv)

        # Migrations: model them via snapshots; copy "migrations" list from latest completed branch snapshot to production via new snapshot
        def _latest_completed(pid):
            c = [s for s in snaps if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("project_id") == pid and s.get("status") == "completed"]
            c.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("completed_at") or x.get("updated_at") or x.get("created_at") or "", reverse=True)
            return c[0] if c else None

        bsnap = _latest_completed(branch_pid)
        psnap = _latest_completed(prod_id)

        # If branch has migrations not in prod (by version/checksum), produce a new prod snapshot with union.
        if bsnap:
            bm = bsnap.get("migrations") if isinstance(bsnap.get("migrations"), list) else []
            pm = psnap.get("migrations") if (psnap and isinstance(psnap.get("migrations"), list)) else []
            pm_index = {(m.get("version"), m.get("checksum")) for m in pm if isinstance(m, dict)}
            to_add = [m for m in bm if isinstance(m, dict) and (m.get("version"), m.get("checksum")) not in pm_index]
            if to_add:
                new_pm = pm + to_add
                ts = _now_iso()
                snaps.append({
                    "id": _gen_id("snap"),
                    "project_id": prod_id,
                    "source": "post_migration",
                    "pg_version": psnap.get("pg_version") if psnap else None,
                    "tables": psnap.get("tables") if psnap and isinstance(psnap.get("tables"), list) else [],
                    "extensions": psnap.get("extensions") if psnap and isinstance(psnap.get("extensions"), list) else [],
                    "migrations": new_pm,
                    "status": "completed",
                    "error_message": None,
                    "started_at": ts,
                    "completed_at": ts,
                    "created_at": ts,
                    "updated_at": ts,
                })
                _save("schema_introspection_snapshots.json", snaps)

        # Finish merge
        br["status"] = "ready"
        br["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
        br["last_error"] = None
        br["last_operation_id"] = None
        _save("branches.json", branches)

        _reqlog("OK", branch_pid, None, {"branch_id": br.get("id"), "production_project_id": prod_id})
        return {"branch": br}
    except Exception as e:
        br["status"] = "failed"
        br["last_error"] = str(e)
        br["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
        _save("branches.json", branches)
        _reqlog("FAILED", br.get("branch_project_id"), "Merge failed", {"error": str(e)})
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Merge failed.", last_error=str(e), branch_id=br.get("id"))

tool_schemas.name: reset_branch
tool_schemas.description: Resets a development branch to the tracked migration state (discarding untracked schema/data changes) and returns the branch record reflecting the reset job state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if branch_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the branch does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to reset it, and CONFLICT if the branch is not in a resettable state or another operation (merge/rebase/delete/reset) is already in progress.

branch_id.description: Branch ID to reset (discarding untracked changes).

tool_schemas.name: rebase_branch
tool_schemas.description: Rebases a development branch on production by applying any newer production migrations onto the branch, returning the branch record reflecting the rebase job state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if branch_id is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the branch does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to rebase it, and CONFLICT if the branch is not in a rebaseable state or another branch operation is already in progress.

branch_id.description: ULID of the branch record to rebase (branches.id).

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists Supabase projects visible to the caller, optionally filtered by environment, region, or status; results are paged with `limit` and an opaque `cursor`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, cursor, or `limit`, and for unknown parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the presented credentials are missing or insufficient.

parent_project_id.description: Optional parent project ID to list child/branch projects for.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single project by `project_id`, returning its stored metadata and current lifecycle status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or unknown parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access; raises NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: update_project
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable project metadata and/or transitions the project lifecycle via `status`. Returns the updated project record. Refuses invalid state transitions (e.g., deleting -> active) with CONFLICT; raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid fields, or unknown parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission.

region.description: Optional region label to store for the project.

status.description: Optional lifecycle transition for the project; only allowed transitions are enforced.

tool_schemas.name: get_edge_function
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Edge Function by `function_id`, returning its metadata including the currently active version reference. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs or unknown parameters; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access; raises NOT_FOUND if the function does not exist.
